summary: Final consistency fix on the authority question, with no new claim. Its limitation said its own experiment exercises only a single-voter configuration and that an election under a stale multi-voter membership is unwitnessed there; that variant has since been witnessed under the child multi-voter question, so this version names receipt abfdbd1823b342409ef4a815bade0407 (minority leadership violated at witness event index 22, control holding at 25) in the execution set with explicit joint history and rescopes the limitation to the single-voter sample. The authority witness itself is unchanged: receipt f5cb1459db5e418d9a9aa6987ef76dfc, comparison 0 violated at witness event index 11 (became_leader false, final state Follower across the 1500 ms window, after_latest_index 0 against an admission with before_latest_index 1) and the flag-off control holding at evaluated index 13 (Leader, index 1). State at expiry is complete and coherent: four questions each with complete violated comparisons and flag-off controls, covering the restart configuration loss (15/18), the blocked NewRaft startup with a large committed backlog and its sub-capacity control, the authority loss after restart (11/13), the multi-voter configuration loss (15/18) together with minority leadership, single-side and concurrent two-sided acknowledgement and post-heal log disagreement (22/25, 27/29, 27/29, 27/29), one resolved gap, one retained durability negative, and knowledge entries for each established behaviour; no further change is warranted.
